user.title: Connect to Plex
user.description: The Plex Media Server that Shortlist writes rows to, and the owner's token. In Plex Web open any title, choose Get Info, then View XML: the token is the X-Plex-Token value in the address bar.

data_description.token: Stays on this Home Assistant; posters are proxied so it never reaches a browser.

reauth_confirm.title: Plex token
reauth_confirm.description: {server} rejected the saved token. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: The server did not answer at that address.

abort.already_configured: This Plex server is already set up.

data.players: TVs and players for the Play button
data.continue_watching: Show the owner's Continue watching row
data.recently_added: Show a New on the server row
data.recent_size: Titles in New on the server
data.watchlist_rows: Keep a To watch row on my Plex Home
data.watchlist_libraries: Libraries to put To watch titles in, preferred first

data_description.players: Leave empty to offer the house's Google Cast devices; the card asks which one each time. Plex clients, Samsung or Android TVs can be listed instead.
data_description.plex_player_for: One line per TV when the Plex client that appears for it should be named: media_player.tv = media_player.plex_tv
data_description.shortlist_url: Optional, for the last-run sensor: where Shortlist's web interface is, for example http://<repository id>-shortlist:5959 (the hostname on the add-on's Info page)
data_description.shortlist_token: Optional: Shortlist's owner API token from its Settings
data_description.watchlist_rows: Copies your Plex Watchlist into a To watch collection in each library that holds its titles, shown on your own Home only. Turn it on in one Home Assistant per Plex server.
data_description.watchlist_libraries: Comma-separated library names, for a title held in several (Movies and 4K Movies): it goes in the first of these that has it. Empty: the server's own library order.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Read the rows from Plex again now.

play.name: Play
play.description: Play a title on a TV through the Plex integration.

rating_key.name: Rating key
rating_key.description: The Plex rating key of the film, show or episode.

player.name: Player
player.description: A Plex client, a Cast device, or a Samsung or Android TV (told to open Plex first).

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Continue from where it was left.
